name: Nels John Olson
sources: Find a Grave, memorial 97722038 (Thomas Mikel Olson, 25 Jun 1894 – 8 Jun 1991, Union Cemetery, Ottosen, Humboldt County) and 98630699 (Clara B. Ronning Olson, 8 Feb 1898 – 22 Jun 1970)
